name: Cruise
source:
Main character is invited on a luxurious cruiser voyage. His first objective is gain trust of a certain VIP passenger. His second objective is to train first class girls into entertainment servants.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角受邀踏上豪华巡洋舰之旅。他的首要目标是获得某位VIP乘客的信任。他的第二个目标是将一流的女孩培养成娱乐仆人。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-september-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
